text: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths{H4615} have I cried{H7121} unto thee, O Jehovah.{H3068}
Lord,{H136} hear{H8085} my voice:{H6963} Let thine ears{H241} be attentive{H7183} To the voice{H6963} of my supplications.{H8469}
If thou, Jehovah,{H3050} shouldest mark{H8104} iniquities,{H5771} O Lord,{H136} who could stand?{H5975}
But there is forgiveness{H5547} with thee, That thou mayest be feared.{H3372}
I wait{H6960} for Jehovah,{H3068} my soul{H5315} doth wait,{H6960} And in his word{H1697} do I hope.{H3176}
My soul{H5315} [waiteth] for the Lord{H136} More than watchmen{H8104} [wait] for the morning;{H1242} [Yea, more than] watchmen{H8104} for the morning.{H1242}
O Israel,{H3478} hope{H3176} in Jehovah;{H3068} For with Jehovah{H3068} there is lovingkindness,{H2617} And with him is plenteous{H7235} redemption.{H6304}
And he will redeem{H6299} Israel{H3478} From all his iniquities.{H5771}
